description: Na₂Zn₃S₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbca space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.80-3.02 Å. There are two inequivalent Zn sites. In the first Zn site, Zn is bonded to four S atoms to form distorted corner-sharing ZnS₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Zn-S bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.49 Å. In the second Zn site, Zn is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent S atoms. Both Zn-S bond lengths are 2.18 Å. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and two Zn atoms. In the second S site, S is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and three equivalent Zn atoms.
